message: I remember a winter storm that knocked out our power for a couple of days. Instead of panicking, I gathered the grandkids, lit some candles, and we turned it into a cozy camping trip right in the living room. We made s'mores in the fireplace and told ghost stories by candlelight. It was a delightful reminder that sometimes, a little prep can turn a tough situation into a warm memory. Have you ever turned an unexpected event into a cozy adventure?
